shortDescription: SANTA MONICA, Calif., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Macerich Company NYSE:MAC today announced that Jackson Hsieh, President and Chief Executive Officer, Dan Swanstrom, Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and Doug Healey, Senior Executive Vice Presiden…

children: today announced that Jackson Hsieh, President and Chief Executive Officer, Dan Swanstrom, Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, and Doug Healey, Senior Executive Vice President Leasing, will present to and speak with investors at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference in New York, NY September 15-16, 2026.

and a copy of the presentation can be accessed from the Company’s website at
. The webcast replay will be available within 24 hours after conclusion of the live event and available at the same location for one year.

is a fully integrated, self-managed, self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT). As a leading owner, operator, and developer of high-quality retail real estate in densely populated and attractive U.S. markets, Macerich’s portfolio is concentrated in California, the Pacific Northwest, Phoenix/Scottsdale, and the Metro New York to Washington, D.C. corridor. Developing and managing properties that serve as community cornerstones, Macerich currently owns approximately 40 million square feet of real estate, consisting primarily of interests in 38 retail centers.

Macerich uses, and intends to continue to use, its Investor Relations website, which can be found at investing.macerich.com, as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with its disclosure obligations under Regulation FD. Additional information about Macerich can be found through social media platforms such as LinkedIn. Reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures, including NOI and FFO, to the most directly comparable GAAP measures are included in the earnings release and supplemental filed on Form 8-K with the SEC, which are posted on the Investor Relations website at investing.macerich.com.

title: Macerich To Present at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference
